semantic_review: not performed by the generator; rule-compatible links remain unassessed

interpretation.literal-overlap: A configured distinctive literal marker occurs in both the source fragment and output segment. This is only a literal property.
interpretation.rule-compatible: The generator claims observable compatibility. Independent semantic review is required.
interpretation.uncertain: The generator reports a possible relationship without asserting compatibility.
interpretation.no-link: An empty links array is an explicit abstention and is always allowed in tagged arms.
